headline: Passed resolution backing Encore Casino workers' strike; enrolled solid waste enterprise fund and reserve stabilization fund ordinances.
summary: Members passed a resolution supporting the strike by Encore Casino and Resort workers, with eight yes votes. They enrolled ordinances creating the Solid Waste Enterprise Fund and the Reserve and Stabilization Fund framework, and ordained a change to a water bill code section. Four appointments were placed on file, one appointment and three lodging house petitions were referred to committees, and the minutes record no action on Paper 285-26.
decisions: Approved the Consent Agenda by a 7-0 vote, with Councillor Taylor excused.
Approved the minutes of the September 22, 2026 meeting.
Placed on file the appointment of Kenneth Antonucci to the Community Preservation Committee.
Placed on file the appointment of Inna Babitskaya to the Community Preservation Committee.
Placed on file the mayoral appointment of Naomi Yohannes to the Commission on Climate Action and Sustainability.
Placed on file the mayoral reappointment of Paul Weston to the Human Rights and Fair Housing Commission.
Referred the mayoral appointment of James Tarr to the Planning Board to the Personnel/Appointments Committee.
Referred the Lodging House petition for Metro North Housing Corp. at 115 Washington Street, Malden, for 14 rooms (renewal), to the License Committee.
Referred the Lodging House petition for Metro North Housing Corp. at 22 Charles Street, Malden, for 11 rooms (renewal), to the License Committee.
Referred the Lodging House petition for Cedar House LLC at 116-118 Cedar Street, Malden, for 14 rooms (renewal), to the License Committee.
Referred Ordinance 415-26, which would add an Assistant Department Head Salary Schedule to the city code, to the Rules & Ordinance Committee, by a 7-0 vote.
Passed Resolution 416-26 expressing support for the strike of the Encore Casino and Resort Workers of Teamsters Local 25 and Unite Here Local 26, by an 8-yea vote.
Ordained Ordinance 390-26, changing the water bill inspection language in MCC 11.20.030(A) from 'at least once each year' to 'monthly', by a 7-0 vote.
Committee recommends Paper 385-26 out favorably to the Full Council.

Committee recommends Paper 388-26 favorably with amendments: change 'financial management team' to 'financial officers'; add ', and anticipated liquidity needs' to the end of 3.10.07(b); and change 'may' to 'shall' in section 3.10.08.
Received and filed the Finance and Rules & Ordinance joint committee report on Papers 385-26 and 388-26, by a 7-0 vote.
Enrolled Ordinance 385-26, adding 3.05 Solid Waste Enterprise Fund to the city code, by a 7-0 vote.
Amended Ordinance 388-26, adding 3.10 Reserve and Stabilization Fund Framework, with the committee's recommended changes, by a 7-0 vote.
Enrolled Ordinance 388-26, adding 3.10 Reserve and Stabilization Fund Framework, by a 7-0 vote.

# City of Malden

Malden City Hall · 215 Pleasant Street · Malden, MA 02148

# Meeting Minutes - Final · City Council

Council President Amanda Linehan · Councillor at Large Karen Colon Hayes · Councillor Paul Condon · Councillor Peg Crowe · Councillor at Large Michelle Luong · Councillor at Large Carey McDonald · Councillor Ryan O'Malley · Councillor Jadeane Sica · Councillor Chris Simonelli · Councillor Ari Taylor · Councillor Stephen Winslow

Tuesday, October 6, 2026 · 7:00 PM · City Council Chambers · 215 Pleasant Street · Malden, MA 02148 · Watch the meeting with Teams: https://tinyurl.com/3shvhudy

## 1. CALL TO ORDER

Council Pro Tempore McDonald called the meeting to order at 7:08 PM. Councillor McDonald is chairing this meeting in the absence of Council President Linehan who was unable to be in attendance this evening.

## 2. PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE & MOMENT OF SILENCE IN HONOR OF SERVICE MEMBERS

An additional moment of silence was offered by Councillor Crowe in honor of Jackie Bouley who passed very suddenly on September 28.

## 3. ROLL CALL

Also in attendance was Zaheer Samee, Lisa Cagno, Maria Luise, and several members of the public.

Councillor Colon Hayes was in attendance via video call so all votes taken this evening were done by roll call vote.

Councillor Taylor was in attendance during the vote on Paper 416-26 but then had a need to leave the meeting early. She vacated the Chamber at 7:27 PM.

Present - Councillors: 8 - Karen Colon Hayes, Paul Condon, Peg Crowe, Carey McDonald, Ryan O'Malley, Jadeane Sica, Ari Taylor and Stephen Winslow

Absent - Councillors: 3 - Amanda Linehan, Chris Simonelli and Michelle Luong

## 4. PUBLIC COMMENT

Almond Pierre of Elwell Street, Malden spoke on behalf of Encore employees in support of Paper 416-26.

## 5. CONSENT AGENDA

### Approval of the Consent Agenda

A motion was made by Councillor Sica , seconded by Councillor O'Malley, to approve the Consent Agenda. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yea: 7 - Colon Hayes, Condon, Crowe, McDonald, O'Malley, Sica and Winslow

Excused: 1 - Taylor

**406-26** 

Minutes for the meeting of September 22, 2026

The Council Minutes were approved.

**407-26**

Attachments: Planning Board's Appointment Letter - Kenneth Antonucci to CPC

This Appointment was placed on file.

## 6. MOTIONS, ORDERS, AND RESOLUTIONS

**415-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) Title 2, Chapter 24 is hereby amended by adding Section .075 ASSISTANT DEPARTMENT HEAD SALARY SCHEDULE and inserting the following positions:

Sponsors: Stephen Winslow

Attachments: Asst. Dept. Salary Schedule 415-26

A motion was made by Councillor Winslow, seconded by Councillor Crowe, that the Ordinance be referred to the Rules & Ordinance Committee. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yea: 7 - Colon Hayes, Condon, Crowe, McDonald, O'Malley, Sica and Winslow

Excused: 1 - Taylor

**416-26** 

Resolution expressing support for the strike of the Encore Casino and Resort Workers of Teamsters Local 25 and Unite Here Local 26

Sponsors: Amanda Linehan, Ryan O'Malley, Ari Taylor, Karen Colon Hayes, Jadeane Sica, Michelle Luong, Stephen Winslow and Carey McDonald

A motion was made by Councillor O'Malley, seconded by Councillor Sica, that the Resolution be passed. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yea: 8 - Colon Hayes, Condon, Crowe, McDonald, O'Malley, Sica, Taylor and Winslow

## 7. ENROLLED ORDINANCES

**390-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC)

11.20.030(A) WATER BILLS; ANNUAL INSPECTION OF PREMISES is hereby amended by striking ‘at least once each year’ and replaced with ‘monthly’.

Sponsors: Stephen Winslow and Carey McDonald

The amendment to this ordinance was just housekeeping updating the language to reflect the longstanding practice of the Treasurer's Office to mail water bills monthly, a change that was adopted in 2008. For this reason, the Body did not find it necessary to refer to sub-committee and unanimously agreed on September 22 to instead enroll on the floor.

A motion was made by Councillor Winslow, seconded by Councillor Sica, that the Ordinance be ordained. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yea: 7 - Colon Hayes, Condon, Crowe, McDonald, O'Malley, Sica and Winslow

Excused: 1 - Taylor

## 8. COMMITTEE REPORTS

**417-26** 

Committee Report: The Standing Committee on Finance in a joint session with Rules & Ordinance to whom was referred Papers 385 and 388 Series of 2026, having considered the same make the following report: the joint committee recommends Paper 385-26 out favorably to the Full Council. Committee additionally recommends Paper 388-26 our favorably with the following amendments: change the term financial management team to financial officers; to add ', and anticipated liquidity needs' to the end of 3.10.07(b); and to change the word ‘may’ to ‘shall’ in section 3.10.08.

A motion was made by Councillor Crowe, seconded by Councillor Winslow, that the Committee Report be received and filed. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yea: 7 - Colon Hayes, Condon, Crowe, McDonald, O'Malley, Sica and Winslow

Excused: 1 - Taylor

**385-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) Title 3 REVENUE AND FINANCE is hereby amended by adding 3.05 SOLID WASTE ENTERPRISE FUND

Sponsors: Stephen Winslow, Karen Colon Hayes, Carey McDonald and Ryan O'Malley

A motion was made by Councillor O'Malley, seconded by Councillor Sica, that the Ordinance be enrolled. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yea: 7 - Colon Hayes, Condon, Crowe, McDonald, O'Malley, Sica and Winslow

Excused: 1 - Taylor

**388-26** 

Be it ordained by the Malden City Council that the Code of the City of Malden (MCC) Title 3 REVENUE AND FINANCE is hereby amended by adding 3.10 RESERVE AND STABILIZATION FUND FRAMEWORK

Sponsors: Amanda Linehan, Carey McDonald, Ryan O'Malley and Stephen Winslow

In a joint session of Finance with the Rules & Ordinance Committees unanimously recommended the following amendments to Paper 388-26: change the term financial management team to financial officers; to add ', and anticipated liquidity needs' to the end of 3.10.07(b); and to change the word ‘may’ to ‘shall’ in section 3.10.08.

A motion was made by Councillor Crowe, seconded by Councillor Winslow, that the Ordinance be amended. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yea: 7 - Colon Hayes, Condon, Crowe, McDonald, O'Malley, Sica and Winslow

Excused: 1 - Taylor

A motion was made by Councillor Winslow, seconded by Councillor Crowe, that the Ordinance be enrolled. The motion carried by the following vote:

Yea: 7 - Colon Hayes, Condon, Crowe, McDonald, O'Malley, Sica and Winslow

Excused: 1 - Taylor

## 9. TABLED PAPERS

**285-26** 

Petition: Massachusetts Electric Company dba National Grid and Verizon New

England, Inc. Plan No. 31115123 - National Grid to install 1 JO pole on Floral Avenue beginning at a point approximately 0 feet northeast of the centerline of the intersection of Floral Avenue and Gordon Street and continuing approximately 20 feet in a northeast direction. National Grid is petitioning to install new pole (P4799-84) and sidewalk guy wire fixture approximately 29 feet southeast off existing pole (P4799) on Floral Avenue Malden, MA.

(Hearing Required)

Attachments: 88 Floral Avenue Petition

Abutters 88 Floral Avenue

Hearing Notice 88 Floral Avenue

Public Hearing Comment Agenda item 285-26

## 10. PERSONAL PRIVILEGE

## 11. ADJOURNMENT

A motion was made by Councillor Winslow, seconded by Councillor Condon, that this meeting be adjourned. The motion carried by the following vote: Meeting adjourned at 7:51 PM.

Yea: 7 - Colon Hayes, Condon, Crowe, McDonald, O'Malley, Sica and Winslow

Excused: 1 - Taylor
